#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>

long genUnos(long n) {
    return (long)(pow(10, n) - 1) / 9;
}

long prog(long n, int tam) {
    long unos = genUnos(1 + tam);
    long veces = n / unos * (1 + tam);
    n %= unos;
    if (n == 0) return veces;
    return veces + std::min((1 + tam) + prog(unos - n, tam - 1), prog(n, tam - 1));
}

int main() {
    long num;
    std::cin >> num;
    std::cout << "" << prog(num, (int)(log10(std::abs(num))) + 1) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
